title: Intraosseous Antibiotics for Osseointegration
summary: The purpose of this research study is to learn about the characteristics of infection in osseointegration patients. This research study will also study how safe and effective it is to use antibiotics inside the bone.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Treated with osseointegration for transfemoral, transhumeral, or transtibial amputation and presenting with concern for surgical site infection
* \>18 years of age

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable to follow up at site for 1 year
* Patients that speak neither English nor Spanish
* \<18 years of age

sites.f: University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus
University of Pennsylvania Perelman School of Medicine
